When this is on, MindTheClub can deliver messages directly over Bluetooth to a nearby contact, with no internet, Wi-Fi or mobile data needed. It\'s handy when you\'re offline or out of signal. The other person must also have Bluetooth enabled and be paired with your device.

When this is on, anyone who scans your QR code or taps your invite link is accepted automatically and added straight to your contact list as pending. They no longer appear in the New contact requests screen for manual approval. Turn it off if you prefer to review and accept each request yourself.

Messages may arrive late, this phone is limiting the app
To save power, Android can put apps to sleep. When that happens to MindTheClub, messages arrive late or only when you open the app. The steps below fix it on your phone.
Names change between models and Android versions. Look for anything about battery, background activity, autostart or sleeping apps.

1. Settings, Battery, Background usage limits
2. Open Deep sleeping apps and remove MindTheClub if it is listed
3. Open Never sleeping apps and add MindTheClub
4. Settings, Apps, MindTheClub, Battery, choose Unrestricted

1. Settings, Apps, Manage apps, MindTheClub
2. Turn on Autostart
3. On the same page open Battery saver and choose No restrictions
4. In Recent apps, hold MindTheClub and tap the padlock
1. Settings, Battery, App battery management\n2. Find MindTheClub and allow background running\n3. Settings, Apps, Startup manager, turn on MindTheClub
1. Settings, Battery, Background power consumption management\n2. Allow MindTheClub to run in the background\n3. Settings, More settings, Applications, Autostart, turn on MindTheClub
1. Settings, Battery, App launch\n2. Find MindTheClub and turn off Manage automatically\n3. Turn on Auto launch, Secondary launch and Run in background
1. Settings, Apps, MindTheClub, Battery\n2. Choose Unrestricted, or remove any restriction you find\n3. If your phone has an autostart or startup manager, allow MindTheClub there too
